plugins.name: rewrite-prompt
plugins.description: Ctrl+P rewrites the draft in the prompt box before you send it

plugins.name: write-for-me
plugins.description: Ctrl+N writes your next prompt from the conversation so far; a draft in the box is used as a hint

plugins.name: prompt-box
plugins.description: Draws your own prompts in the scrollback inside a thick colored box

plugins.name: tool-oneline
plugins.description: Folds tool calls in the scrollback into one line per call, or one line per run of calls
